---
title: "Pipelines"
---

Exacto's commands compose into three end-to-end pipelines for long-read analysis. Each page below
walks through the inputs, the intermediate files and the final outputs, with links to the commands.

## Available Pipelines

[**Mutant Proteoform Prediction**](mutant-proteoform-prediction.qmd)<br/>
Call somatic DNA variants and RNA variants from long-read DNA and RNA, link them, and translate the
assembled transcripts to mutant proteoforms and peptides.


[**Variant-aware Transcriptome Assembly**](variant-aware-transcriptome-assembly.qmd)<br/>
Cluster long RNA reads into transcripts, correct sequencing errors, re-cluster, build one consensus
sequence per transcript, restore degraded ends from the reference, and call RNA variants.


[**Variation Graph Construction**](variation-graph-construction.qmd)<br/>
Build individualized genome and transcriptome variation graphs from variant calls.
